A '''condensing canteen''' was a type of [[Canteen/Legends|canteen]] that had a built-in [[Water/Legends|water]] purification system. A [[field kit]] was equipped with two condensing canteens.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
